verdict.rationale: The evidence describes ComplyAdvantage Mesh as an AML product: sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, risk scoring, transaction monitoring and case management. None of these collect biometric data, so lawful biometric handling (GDPR bases, BIPA, consent language) is outside this product's category. Nothing in the pack shows it ships biometric identity verification, which would have made the axis apply.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor documents how biometric data is handled lawfully — GDPR bases, US biometric statutes like BIPA, and the consent language my flow needs — so legal review has something to review
